headline: Investment Trend Rises, Stock Investors in NTB and NTT Grow 120%
summary: Stock investors in West Nusa Tenggara and East Nusa Tenggara grew 122% and 126.88% respectively as of September 2026, with OJK promoting public investment education.
why: Growing retail participation in Indonesian equities broadens the investor base of the Indonesia Stock Exchange. The OJK regulates the country's capital markets.
original_headline: Tren Investasi Meningkat, Investor Saham di NTB dan NTT Tumbuh 120%
